name: Corn/Soybean Spread Mean-Reversion Strategy
description:
**Pairs trading strategy** using CORN and SOYB ETFs as proxies for corn/soybean futures spread.

**Core concept**: The CORN/SOYB price ratio oscillates around a mean. When the ratio deviates significantly (measured by z-score), bet on mean reversion.

**Seasonal filter**: Only enter during USDA announcement windows:
- **Window 1**: Feb 1 - Apr 30 (planting intentions)
- **Window 2**: June 1 - July 31 (acreage report)

**Spread mechanics**:
- *Long spread* (z < -1.5): Long CORN, Short SOYB (ratio is cheap)
- *Short spread* (z > +1.5): Short CORN, Long SOYB (ratio is expensive)
- *Aggressive add* at ±2.0 sigma in same direction
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN/SOYBEAN SPREAD MEAN-REVERSION STRATEGY
# =============================================================================
# Pairs trading using CORN and SOYB ETFs as proxies for ZC/ZS futures spread.
# Strategy: Mean-reversion on the CORN/SOYB price ratio z-score.
# Entry: Z-score crosses ±1.5 (primary) or ±2.0 (aggressive add)
# Exit: Z-score reverts to ±0.5 OR seasonal window closes
# Seasonal Windows: Feb-Apr (planting) and Jun-Jul (acreage)
# =============================================================================

# === SECTION 1: DATA SOURCES ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Reference stocks for spread calculation
soyb_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="SOYB")()
corn_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="CORN")()

# Asset identification
is_corn = is_asset_ref(ticker="CORN")()
is_soyb = is_asset_ref(ticker="SOYB")()

# === SECTION 2: RATIO & Z-SCORE CALCULATION ===
# Build CORN/SOYB ratio consistently regardless of which asset is primary
corn_price = (close if is_corn else corn_ref.c)
soyb_price = (soyb_ref.c if is_corn else close)

# CORN/SOYB price ratio
ratio = corn_price / soyb_price

# 60-day rolling z-score of the ratio
z_score = zscore(window=60)(ratio)
z_score_prev = z_score >> 1

# === SECTION 3: SEASONAL WINDOWS ===
bar_idx = index()
month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(bar_idx)

# Window 1: Feb 1 - Apr 30 (USDA planting intentions)
in_window_1 = month >= 2 and month <= 4

# Window 2: June 1 - July 31 (USDA acreage report)
in_window_2 = month >= 6 and month <= 7

# Combined seasonal window
in_seasonal_window = in_window_1 or in_window_2

# Detect window transitions for time stop
was_in_window = in_seasonal_window >> 1
window_just_closed = was_in_window and not in_seasonal_window

# === SECTION 4: SPREAD ENTRY SIGNALS (direction-neutral) ===
# Short spread: z crosses ABOVE +1.5 → ratio expensive → short CORN, long SOYB
cross_above_1_5 = z_score > 1.5 and z_score_prev <= 1.5
cross_above_2_0 = z_score > 2.0 and z_score_prev <= 2.0

# Long spread: z crosses BELOW -1.5 → ratio cheap → long CORN, short SOYB
cross_below_neg_1_5 = z_score < -1.5 and z_score_prev >= -1.5
cross_below_neg_2_0 = z_score < -2.0 and z_score_prev >= -2.0

# Entry conditions (only during seasonal windows)
short_spread_entry = in_seasonal_window and (cross_above_1_5 or cross_above_2_0)
long_spread_entry = in_seasonal_window and (cross_below_neg_1_5 or cross_below_neg_2_0)

# === SECTION 5: SPREAD EXIT SIGNALS ===
# Mean reversion exit for short spread: z reverts to +0.5
short_spread_mean_exit = z_score < 0.5 and z_score_prev >= 0.5

# Mean reversion exit for long spread: z reverts to -0.5
long_spread_mean_exit = z_score > -0.5 and z_score_prev <= -0.5

# Time stop: exit when seasonal window closes
short_spread_time_exit = window_just_closed
long_spread_time_exit = window_just_closed

# Combined exit signals
short_spread_exit = short_spread_mean_exit or short_spread_time_exit
long_spread_exit = long_spread_mean_exit or long_spread_time_exit

# === SECTION 6: PER-ASSET POSITION DIRECTION ===
# CORN: Long spread = LONG, Short spread = SHORT
# SOYB: Long spread = SHORT, Short spread = LONG (opposite)

enter_long = (long_spread_entry if is_corn else short_spread_entry)
enter_short = (short_spread_entry if is_corn else long_spread_entry)
exit_long = (long_spread_exit if is_corn else short_spread_exit)
exit_short = (short_spread_exit if is_corn else long_spread_exit)

# Hold until exit conditions
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short, exit=exit_short)

# === SECTION 7: EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Equal dollar weight: 25% per leg for balanced spread exposure
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=25)

# === SECTION 8: EVENT MARKERS ===
# Long Spread Entry (z crosses below -1.5)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long Spread Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Window', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
        ]
    )
)(long_spread_entry, z_score, ratio, ("Feb-Apr" if in_window_1 else "Jun-Jul"))

# Short Spread Entry (z crosses above +1.5)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Short Spread Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Window', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
        ]
    )
)(short_spread_entry, z_score, ratio, ("Feb-Apr" if in_window_1 else "Jun-Jul"))

# Mean Reversion Exit
mean_reversion_exit = short_spread_mean_exit or long_spread_mean_exit
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Mean Reversion Exit',
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(mean_reversion_exit, z_score, ratio)

# Window Exit (time stop)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Window Exit',
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(window_just_closed, z_score, ratio)

# === SECTION 9: DASHBOARD - Z-SCORE VISUALIZATION ===
timeseries_lines(
    title='CORN/SOYB Ratio Z-Score',
    category='Spread Analysis',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2.0 Aggressive', color=Color.Error, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5, title='+1.5 Entry', color=Color.Error, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='+0.5 Exit', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title='-0.5 Exit', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5 Entry', color=Color.Success, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2.0 Aggressive', color=Color.Success, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(z_score)

timeseries_lines(
    title='CORN/SOYB Price Ratio',
    category='Spread Analysis',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio', color=Color.Indigo)
    ])
)(ratio)

# Seasonal window indicator
window_flag = (1.0 if in_seasonal_window else 0.0)
timeseries_lines(
    title='Seasonal Window Active',
    category='Spread Analysis',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='In Window (1=Yes)', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    step=StepType.StepRight
)(window_flag)
